screens.name: Named-person editor — selected person and populated name

screens.name: Adaptive questions — unselected cards 1, 2 and 3

screens.name: Adaptive questions — selected, final-selected and retained-answer recovery

screens.name: Adaptive questions — keyboard-focused selected choice

screens.name: Expanded editor — question and custom answer across all supplied sizes
screens.evidence: Sheets 32–37 show both editors at 360/390/430 widths and 500/844 heights, with supplied evidence reporting retained drafts, Cancel/Done semantics and restored focus.

screens.name: Voice entry — start failure and typing fallback

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation

screens.name: Birth city — empty and retained draft

limitations: These are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; I did not independently execute the reported checks.
Corresponding transition captures are grouped with settled screens; sampled frames support visual continuity but cannot establish motion quality by themselves.
Scores use the six requested dimensions; A is the mean of the first three applicable dimensions, F the mean of the last three, and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all represented screens and components.
No hard-gate failure is conclusively established by this deck; viewport cropping alone does not prove inaccessible content, and supplied evidence reports scrolling and recovery.
The long enlarged share notices warrant targeted reachability checks because the screenshots do not show their entire content or an obvious internal scrolling affordance.
Native keyboard, physical iPhone Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, native motion, haptics, OS sharing, reminders and real payments remain unverified; browser scores do not certify those boundaries.
Circles is demonstrated only offline; authenticated, populated and successful connection states cannot be graded from the supplied material.
Speech and invitation sharing use mocks, consent uses a separate preview, billing is simulated, and reminder dates are synthetic.
Synthetic wording, stress repetitions and layout predictions were treated as fixtures, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
The original Share motion failure remains material evidence despite the unchanged-code isolated pass; its cause and physical-device performance remain unresolved.
Some reported boundaries, including rejected empty person names and intermediate city-request failure, lack directly identifiable screenshots in this deck.
topFixes: Stack share preview, export action and status at 200% so controls and recovery copy have sufficient width.
Replace raw friend-link notices with labeled links and clearly scrollable long-message content above Dismiss.
Improve navigation through long reading details and simplify the preserved-explanation preamble while retaining every recorded passage.
Keep check-in persistence status beside Save outcome and keep enlarged Sky selection feedback closer to its choices.
Clarify the unavailable omen entry point and its separate daily allowance.
Refine enlarged heading spacing, standardize disclosure symbols and reduce mist contrast behind dense content.
